card.name: Length number before inch or cm
card.fires_on: A number (1, 2, 4, 8-10) or a space right before a length unit such as inch, inches or cm. Mostly in injection-site spacing instructions, such as keeping sites a set distance apart or away from the navel.

modes.label: Injection site spacing
modes.description: A number after 'at least' that gives how far apart injection sites should be, before inch.
modes.example: the injection sites should be at least <<1>> inch apart.

modes.label: Area around the navel
modes.description: A number or the word two before a hyphenated inch, describing the area to avoid.
modes.example: except for a<< two>>-inch area right around the navel

modes.label: Other distances in cm
modes.description: A number before cm outside injection spacing, such as an implant location or a general fact.
modes.example: The moon moves away from the earth at around <<4>>cm per year.

card.writes: It raises length units such as cm and inch as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on a measurement number just before the unit of length, like inch or cm, is written.
